description.content:
## Loopay open API 
 You will find a complete guide and information to start working with Loopay integrations as soon as possible, as well as support if you get lost, so let's dive right in! 

 ## Integration guide
 For production, please contact your personal Looper.

 ## Authetication guide
 Loopay uses a token-based authentication system, which means that you will need to generate a token to be able to use the API. 

 ### How to generate a token
 To generate a token, you will need to send a POST  request to the following endpoint: 

 `/login`  [See  User/post ](/explorer/#/User/User.login)  

  ⚠ **Disclaimer**: All examples listed below are run in a secure environment ready for testing.

Contact Support:
 Name: Loopay Team
